decision: recorded baseline: bun 68 pass 0 fail, watch-pr typecheck 0 errors, statechart 27 pass 0 fail 31 skip

decision: broke the base on purpose twice, a byte in skills/how/SKILL.md and the exec bit on watch-pr, then restored both
